name: Usako
source:
A cosmic wraith who looks like bunny girl and Mei Mei's subordinate.  She loves nothing more than sex.

When using human speech, she always ends her sentences with "~usa" and "~pyon".  She and her cheerful friends go by: Red Usa, Blacks Usa, Pink Usa, and Gold Usa.

They are a semi-endangered species. They are in heat all year round and are incredibly fertile. If they find a male, they will produce many offspring in a short period of time. They have a habit of always getting pregnant.

They are a species that comes in many different colors. Their personalities differ depending on the color. Some are incredibly loving, some are nymphomaniacs who are addicted to human semen, and some find joy in dominating males. But they all have one thing in common, they love sex with human beings.

They are proactive in finding a mate but will not be overly aggressive about it. In most cases they will seek out a partner in a friendly manner. They have a tendency to die when they are lonely, so they like to stick close and cuddle.
